data.name: Imanvi
data.gender_notes: Imanvi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Imanvi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Imana’, which refers to the dwelling place of the goddess Imana. In Hindu mythology, Imana is a goddess of abundance and prosperity. The name Imanvi symbolizes the divine presence that resides within one's home and heart. The name Imanvi carries the meaning “Goddess Imana's dwelling” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Imanvi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess imana's dwelling and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that connects one to the divine presence and abundance in life.
data.etymology: Imanvi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Imana's dwelling.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imanvi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Imanvi holds a significant cultural impact as it is connected to the rich Hindu mythology and tradition. In Hindu culture, the name evokes a sense of reverence and honor towards the goddess Imana, who is believed to bestow abundance and prosperity upon her devotees. The name is also a reminder of the importance of the home and the role it plays in nurturing and sustaining life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Imanvi holds deep spiritual significance as it represents the divine feminine energy of abundance and prosperity. It is a symbol of the inner goddess that resides within each individual, reminding us of the abundance and richness that exists within ourselves. The name also serves as a reminder of the divine presence that surrounds us, inspiring us to live our lives with gratitude, and to share our blessings with others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Imanvi, a name of divine grace, evokes the image of the infinite Goddess, symbolizing boundless love and compassion. It echoes the rhythm of the heart, resonating with the eternal tune of the soul.
